Frontend Documents tab renders 4 DocFileBlocks (Aadhaar/PAN/Profile Photo/Bank), full upload→replace→delete flow works with correct toasts, metadata (filename/size/uploaded-at) and View/Replace/Delete controls. Admin educators card shows avatar, city+state, availability, experience and green 'Documents verified' badge for Usha Bihani (Archived tab). Both backend and frontend features verified end-to-end.
critical_code_review_comments: educators.py is 3461 lines — well over the 700-line threshold and should be split into smaller modules (profile/onboarding/documents/interviews).

Upload endpoint reads entire file into memory before size check — a malicious client could still consume up to 50MB RAM per request; consider streaming size check or Content-Length pre-check for very large uploads.
In _EDUCATOR_DOC_ALLOWED_EXT / _EDUCATOR_DOC_IMAGE_EXT the check is filename-suffix-based only — no MIME sniffing. Acceptable for MVP but flag for future security tightening.
